legal.defendant_current_status: The current job or profession of the defendant (follows the same rules as for the plaintiff; e.g., government)
legal.judge_name: identifier for the judge overseeing the trial (e.g., arshall J.)
legal.fine_amount: The total monetary value of fines applied in the case (include all fines, partial payments, and fines for various parties; indicate blank if no fines exist; e.g., 250000)
legal.plaintiff_current_status: current employment status or type of the claimant (if singular person, provide their job title; for multiple individuals, use the first one's job title; if entity, specify as organization; if firm, categorize as company; if governmental, label as government; omit if unspecified; e.g., company)
legal.judgment_year: The year in which the judgment was issued; represented as YYYY (for example, 2009).
